conclusionES: Observación por valoración: crecimiento normalizado aproximadamente 4%, FCFF condicionado $40/$74/$106 frente a $122,38. Margen inverso 29,42% con financiación del crecimiento de ingresos y margen. Puente de capital parcialmente conciliado; no entrada aprobada.
conclusionEN: Valuation watch: normalized growth around 4%, conditional FCFF $40/$74/$106 versus $122.38. Inverse margin 29.42% with revenue and margin growth funded. Capital bridge partly reconciled; no approved entry.

pros.es: Q3 crece 5% orgánico, con fortaleza en aeroespacial y arquitectura latinoamericana.
pros.en: Q3 organic growth is 5%, supported by aerospace and Latin American architectural coatings.
pros.evidence: Third-quarter sales increased 6.6% to $4,353m: company attribution is 3% price, 2% volume, 1% currency and 1% acquisitions, rounded. Organic growth is 5%, not 7%. Global Architectural segment income rose from $184m to $225m and Performance from $272m to $332m, while Industrial fell from $233m to $200m despite higher sales. Nine-month Industrial income fell from $675m to $622m. Corporate costs also rose. Thus aerospace and Latin American architectural strength are offset by other businesses and costs. The base case assumes organic growth, not free future acquisitions.
pros.provenance: Analyst synthesis and calculations from cited primary report; evidence is exact contiguous report text.

cons.es: El EBIT publicado exagera la mejora operativa; el subtotal TTM solo crece 4%.
cons.en: Published EBIT overstates the operating improvement; the TTM subtotal grows only 4%.
cons.evidence: 1. TTM sales rose 6.39%. Published unlevered EBIT rose 22.65%, but the operating subtotal rose just 4.01%, from $2,172m to $2,259m. Subtotal margin declined from 13.84% to 13.53%. The large published increase is substantially comparison-base effects, not broad margin expansion.
cons.provenance: Analyst synthesis and calculations from cited primary report; evidence is exact contiguous report text.

cons.es: Juicio por óxido de etileno programado; pérdidas no estimables, sin resultado confirmado.
cons.en: Ethylene-oxide trial scheduled; losses not estimable and no confirmed outcome.
cons.evidence: The first ethylene-oxide trial is a real near-term catalyst. The issuer cannot reasonably estimate losses. Do not translate awards against unrelated defendants into a PPG liability, assume insurance recovery, or multiply plaintiffs by an arbitrary award. Pure arithmetic stress: an additional after-tax cash loss of $100m / $500m / $1bn would subtract $0.45 / $2.24 / $4.48 per share at today's share count. These amounts have no assigned probability and are not predictions or an upper bound. They are separate from recurring environmental costs and the WACC assumptions.
cons.provenance: Analyst synthesis and calculations from cited primary report; evidence is exact contiguous report text.
